description:
Staff identity with roles (box office / admin / finance), the event & inventory builder UI, order management console (lookup, refund, exchange, resend, holds).

**Conditions of Success:**
- Role matrix enforced server-side; box-office staff cannot touch settlement
- Organizer builds a sellable event end-to-end in the UI without API calls
- Console handles the full order lifecycle staff-side

Lineage: docs/product/brief.md · docs/product/prd-v1.md (capability map).

comments.body: COS defined at epic level. Not yet decomposed — US-stories are created when the owner prioritizes this epic (Gate 1), per PRD 'Capability map'.
